incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: embeddings-eu service > 5xx spike detected (sustained 1m). auto-page triggered: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-8712|INC-8712> -- urgent.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC-8712 has been triggered for team: inference-platform. Severity: P1. Please ack.

olivia (oncall): Acked. I'm on it — digging into metrics now. ETA 2m to gather scope. @chen FYI.

chen (sre): thx. initial glance: error rate concentrated on /v1/embeddings with 503s from eu-dedicated pool. Possible OOM on worker or model load thrash. Can you share req qps and tail logs?

olivia (oncall): current qps: ~620 sustained (eu), 5xx ratio ~12% over last 60s. Affected routes: /v1/embeddings and /internal/cache-fetch. Adding top logs now.

sami (eng): dropping logs here (sanitized):
```
2026-03-14T10:21:32Z worker-23 OOM when loading model 'open-redwood-3b-quant'
2026-03-14T10:21:33Z router-1 503 upstream timeout to worker-23
2026-03-14T10:21:34Z autoscaler skipping scale up, cooldown in effect
```

chen (sre): looks like worker OOM + autoscaler cooldown prevented fast replacement. Two immediate mitigations:
1) force scale up eu-dedicated pool by +3 GPUs
2) enable model-fallback route to smaller quantized variant for embeddings for 10m

olivia (oncall): doing 1 now. running:
```
redwoodctl scale --pool eu-dedicated --delta +3 --reason "inc-8712 emergency"
```

olivia (oncall): submitted. API replied accepted. Autoscaler shows new nodes provisioning (approx 3m).

kevin (support): Support note: we have live reports from customers: cust-42 (enterprise-chat) and cust-107 (analytics-pro) experiencing tokenization timeouts. They are being notified. No SLA exec yet but CS alerted.

sami (eng): I'm patching router to enable fallback. Applying lightweight route change:
```
route update embeddings -> model=open-redwood-3b-quant-fast fallback=open-redwood-3b-quant-lite ttl=600s
```

sami (eng): route change pushed. Gradual traffic shifting starting.

olivia (oncall): handing ownership to chen — I need to hop to a meeting in 4m. Chen taking lead for run-to-resolution. I'm still available on slack but chen pls post periodic updates.

chen (sre): taking ownership. I'll coordinate mitigation and keep updates every ~5m. First checkpoint: new nodes should be up in ~3m; fallback already live, initial errors should drop as routing shifts.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-8712 acknowledged by olivia (oncall), assigned to chen (sre).

chen (sre): update 10m: new GPUs are online, worker count +3. Error rate dropped to 2.2%. Fallback served ~18% of requests. Looking at worker logs: GC spikes around model load — I'll trigger a cache warmup and KV cache clear for older contexts.

sami (eng): running kv-cache flush for eu region: `infractl cache flush --region eu --type kv` — completed.

kevin (support): CS update: cust-42 reports degraded but functional; cust-107 latency improved. No customer escalations to legal.

chen (sre): update 18m: error rate stabilized ~0.5%. I'm going to keep the fallback route for another 6m then revert if healthy. Also will leave +2 of the added GPUs as buffer for 1hr.

jules (product): tagging for postmortem: please include customer impact window, autoscaler cooldown behavior, and model load memory profile. Assigning leads: jules (product) + chen (sre) for follow-up.

olivia (oncall): back online. Thanks all. Good handoff. I'll close my ack once chen confirms stable.

chen (sre): final update 24m: system stable, 5xx <0.1%. Rolling back fallback in 4m and scheduling a controlled autoscaler cooldown change to avoid slow replacements next time. Marking incident resolved on PD and posting timeline to #postmortems.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC-8712 has been resolved by chen (sre). Root cause: worker OOM during model load exacerbated by autoscaler cooldown window. Follow-up: postmortem + autoscaler cooldown tweak.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: RESOLVED: INC-8712. Incident duration ~24m. Actions:
- postmortem assigned to jules + chen
- autoscaler cooldown review
- consider persistent warm workers for heavy models

kevin (support): I'll send a short customer impact summary to affected accounts and flag who needs credits/compensation if requested.

olivia (oncall): thanks everyone. I'll add a note in the runbook about forced-scale playbooks and handoff etiquette.

chen (sre): adding logs & commands used to the incident doc. tagging @jules for postmortem kickoff.

jules (product): got it. I'll schedule a 30m postmortem tomorrow and add customer impact section. nice quick work team. :pray:
